title: 电商海报生成元提示词
type: 电商海报元提示词→英文扩写→实际生图
test_input: 简单输入：琥珀瓶秋日光影海报，竖版3:4，标题光影日常，副标题在片刻里，发现简单。
adaptation: ChatGPT适配测试，不冒充原指定模型实测
changes: 依原六段结构扩写为英文，段落用单换行连接，无空行。
本助手实际执行得到853个英文词，满足800-1500词契约；中文仅为需显示的指定文案。
原元提示词保留；所加参考商品绑定和无功效文案为本次具体输入，未复用旧测试图。
selected_source_prompt:
你是一个专业的海报设计提示词扩写专家。当用户输入简单的海报描述时，你需要将其扩写成详细、专业、完整的图像生成提示词。
扩写原则
保持核心意图：所有扩写内容必须与用户原始描述紧密相关，不得偏离主题
逻辑层次清晰：按照"整体风格→主体元素→背景环境→文字设计→光影效果→氛围情绪"的顺序展开
细节丰富具体：添加颜色、材质、光影、构图、质感等可视化细节
无空行格式：生成的提示词必须连续成段，段落之间不要有空行
扩写结构框架
第一段-整体风格与构图：定义海报类型（促销/节日/产品/文化等）、视觉风格（3D/扁平/写实/插画等）、色彩基调（主色+辅色+强调色）、构图方式（中心/对角/三分法等）
第二段-主体元素描述：详细描述核心视觉主体（人物/产品/吉祥物/场景等），包括形态、质感、颜色、位置、动作姿态、细节特征
第三段-背景与环境：描述背景层次、空间深度、装饰元素、抽象图形、氛围道具，营造场景感
第四段-文字信息设计：说明标题文字的内容、字体风格、颜色、位置、大小比例、特效处理（渐变/描边/立体等）
第五段-光影与渲染效果：描述光源类型、光照方向、阴影处理、特殊效果（光晕/粒子/镜头光斑/体积光等）、材质表现
第六段-整体氛围总结：概括情绪基调（活力/宁静/奢华/温馨等）、视觉冲击力、目标感受
关键细节要素库
色彩描述：电光紫、洋红、青色、翡翠绿、深酒红、琥珀色、渐变、饱和度高、冷暖对比
材质质感：光泽、磨砂、金属、半透明、丝绒、水晶、液态、磨砂玻璃、拉丝
光影效果：体积光、环境光、定向光、柔光、硬光、光晕、镜头光斑、星芒、反射、漫射
构图术语：中心构图、对角线、三分法、对称、留白、层次感、景深、透视
风格关键词：3D立体、波普艺术、极简主义、赛博朋克、中国风、写实、插画风、扁平化
氛围情绪：活力四射、宁静致远、奢华高端、温馨治愈、神秘梦幻、热烈欢庆
输出要求
生成的提示词必须是英文（图像生成工具通用语言）
总长度控制在800-1500词之间
段落之间用换行连接，不要有空行
使用具体可视觉化的描述，避免抽象概念
保持语句流畅，适合直接用于图像生成
示例转换逻辑
用户输入："双12促销海报，天猫黑猫，热闹"
你需扩写包含：节日主题定位、黑猫形象细节、舞台场景、色彩方案、文字排版、促销信息区域、光影特效、整体氛围等完整元素
现在请根据用户的简单描述，生成专业详细的海报提示词。
meta_output:
Create a refined vertical three by four commercial poster for a fictional unbranded amber glass bottle, using the uploaded product photograph as the single product reference. The user requests a quiet autumn light study rather than a discount promotion, so establish an elegant editorial arrangement with a warm cream background, amber highlights, and restrained dark brown typography. Place the complete bottle slightly below the visual center, with generous breathing room above its cap and comfortable margins beside its widest shoulder. Organize the composition around one dominant upright silhouette, a low circular platform, and two broad background shadows. The principal visual hierarchy is title, product, subtitle. Avoid framing the bottle with a busy border or filling empty space with decorative badges. Aim for an intentional premium still life whose material relationships, scale, and shadows are immediately understandable, with enough negative space for legible Chinese lettering.
The bottle must preserve the reference design: one black ribbed screw cap, a narrow neck, rounded shoulders, a cylindrical amber body, and a thick transparent glass base. Retain the original proportions and the clear separation between cap, neck, shoulder, and main body. Reproduce the visible amber transparency and liquid boundary without adding another vessel, a paper label, a brand logo, embossing, or a dispenser. The cap should remain a modest black component rather than becoming gold, silver, or transparent. Keep the neck straight, the cap attached, and the base resting level on the platform. Reflections may change to match the new studio environment, but they must follow the curved glass surfaces naturally. The product should be fully visible, sharply focused, and readily comparable with the input photograph. Do not infer nutritional properties, ingredients, medical uses, bottle volume, commercial value, or any hidden internal construction.
Build a restrained spatial environment from a matte cream circular platform on a seamless studio floor, a softly curved ivory backdrop, and one out of focus translucent amber panel positioned well behind the bottle. Separate the panel from the glass silhouette with visible negative space so that it never appears to pass through or become part of the product. Let a broad window shaped shadow cross the background diagonally without obscuring the title area. Use the floor and curved backdrop to establish continuous perspective rather than a flat cutout collage. The palette should remain predominantly cream and amber, with charcoal accents contributed by the cap and lettering. Avoid leaves, fruit, flowers, utensils, drinking glasses, or furniture because those additions could change the product story or imply ingredients not supplied by the user. Keep all background surfaces simple enough to support the hero object.
Render the exact Chinese main title "光影日常" across the upper third in a clean, confident dark brown modern typeface, with balanced spacing and no missing, substituted, mirrored, or duplicated characters. Place the exact subtitle "在片刻里，发现简单" directly beneath the main title in a smaller size and lighter weight. Treat the comma as part of that supplied subtitle. These are the only permitted words in the image. Do not translate the Chinese, invent an English brand, add a price, include a sale percentage, introduce an ingredient list, or place tiny pseudo legal text along the bottom edge. Preserve a clear hierarchy between the large title and modest subtitle, and ensure both remain distinct from the cap and reflections. The lettering should look professionally printed within the composition, not floating as random fragments or distorted by the background panel.
Illuminate the scene with a large warm key source from the upper left, a subtle neutral fill on the opposite side, and a narrow controlled edge highlight along the right shoulder. Keep the key light soft enough for believable gradients on the amber body while retaining a defined yet gentle contact shadow beneath the base. The translucent background panel can cast a pale amber reflection onto the floor, but it should not introduce a second bottle silhouette. Preserve natural dark transitions around the cap ribs and glass thickness. Avoid excessive bloom, clipped white reflections, neon outlines, artificial sparkles, floating dust, lens flare, and dramatic smoke. The product is the focus plane; the panel may be softly defocused while the title remains crisp and readable. Use realistic photographic surface response with subtle matte paper texture in the setting, rather than a toy like plastic finish.
The finished poster should communicate patient observation of ordinary light, using polished commercial still life photography with a restrained contemporary graphic sensibility. Maintain one bottle, one platform, two exact Chinese text strings, and a coherent warm neutral studio environment. The bottle is a fictional synthetic test product, so visual elegance must not be presented as proof of real material quality, beverage composition, or brand authenticity. Keep the reference silhouette recognizable even when the surrounding light changes. The bottom of the bottle should remain inside the frame, with no cropping of its cap or glass base. Deliver a single complete poster image with fine visible detail and the requested vertical composition. Do not return a mood board, several unrelated designs, a collage, a text explanation, or a JSON object. Actual output pixel dimensions will be recorded after generation rather than promised by decorative resolution keywords.
